artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: ISSUER AMENDMENT (reopen on row Z-W4-S1): business_type_of_security(security_key, xlsx_records, fetch_extraction) collects the value following every 'Sector' label (case-insensitive, trailing colon ignored) across a security's own XLSX extractions -- coordinate-free adjacency, a stated working rule -- maps each through taxonomy.scanner_sectors_for, and returns the security's own business type per the amendment's own MECE rules (one mapped sector; several sectors from one value joined by '+'; empty tuple/Excel error -> unmapped with the raw value; two different mapped types across workbooks -> unmapped with reason conflict, never picked). _group_by_business_type/_summarise_rows/current_inputs are re-wired onto {security_key: (business_type, reason, entries)} so every non-OTHER report of a security inherits its security's type; business_type_of(record) (report-level) is kept, unchanged, evidence-only. METHOD_VERSION bumped 1->2 (new keys, no S3 delete). _run_show_first_graded's kpi/section printout capped to the TOP 20 by count each plus a kpis_total/sections_total line (the amendment's own output-budget clause, since AC2 reads tail -60). MEASURED on the real 123-object corpus (python -m lib.research.corpus.sector_template --write): 30 of 33 XLSX-carrying securities resolve to a single business type (3 unmapped: 1 Excel-error '#NAME?', 2 genuine cross-workbook conflicts), 8 business types produced, reports_typed 49, unmapped_reports 2, other_excluded 72 -- against the first run's 0 types / 51 unmapped_reports.

8 new offline tests under the poison for business_type_of_security: THE BRIDGE IS USED (a GICS-worded 'Information Technology' and a scanner-worded 'Technology' land in ONE business type across two workbooks of the SAME security); NO HAND MAPPING (an unknown string -> unmapped with the raw value); an Excel error '#NAME?' -> unmapped; no 'Sector' label at all -> unmapped with no entries; TWO DIFFERENT mapped types across a security's own workbooks -> unmapped with reason 'conflict: finance, technology', never picked; a multi-sector value ('Consumer Discretionary') -> ONE type keyed on the sorted sectors joined by '+'; adjacency is coordinate-free per sheet (the value used is whatever comes next in that SAME sheet's own labels list); no XLSX records at all -> unmapped, no crash. Plus _group_by_business_type re-tested against a stubbed security_types map (every report inherits its security's type) and _summarise_rows's two pre-existing denominator tests updated to the new (rows, security_types) signature plus one new case (a security absent from security_types types unmapped). business_type_of(record)'s own 4 pre-existing tests untouched and still pass (it is now evidence-only but its own behaviour is unchanged).
